Promptr Studio Pro 5.121

3D Composer

  • Big sets. 3D Paul now takes the time large sets need, like a whole city skyline, instead of stopping halfway.
  • Suggestions that fit. Ideas for motion and camera now come from what is actually in your scene, and suggestions you close stay closed.

Workspace

  • Folders stay open. Hiding or narrowing the sidebar, switching tabs or restarting keeps your open folders as they were.

Promptr Studio Pro 5.120

A big update with many new features, led by a heavily reworked 3D Composer.

3D Composer

  • Build, shoot, film. A clearer layout with three steps, a command bar for 3D Paul and push to talk.
  • Starter worlds. Start a new scene from eight ready-made worlds, from a street with shops to a harbor, a forest or a parking lot, with light, camera and people in place.
  • Sets in minutes. Houses, walls, streets, furniture, vehicles and nature as ready-made parts, now also shop signs, awnings, puddles, fountains, monuments, vintage and sports cars, plus quick light presets for time of day.
  • Location from photo. Load a photo in build mode and 3D Paul rebuilds the place as a set, with matching light and camera.
  • Realistic people. New figures come as realistic people with a natural walk. Prefer simple shapes? Swap people for rough figures with one click.
  • Extras. Fill a scene with people who stand, stroll or talk on their own.
  • Cyclists pedal. Riders pedal in time with the ride and stop when the bike stops.
  • Real camera work. Depth of field with aperture and focus, several cameras per scene and editing straight from the camera view.
  • Smooth playback. Playing and shooting a scene now runs fluidly.

New models

  • Kling 4. Text, start and end frame, or up to 10 images and 5 videos as references, 3 to 30 seconds in 720p or 1080p.
  • Kling 4 Edit. Rework an existing video with a prompt and optional reference images.

AI assistants

  • Use the whole app from Claude. AI assistants connected to Promptr Studio Pro can now fill the composer, add references, edit images and videos, organize the gallery and build 3D scenes.

Workspace

  • Guided start. New users can take a short tour or finish the ending of an example film step by step.
  • Project tab menu. Every project tab has a dropdown with all project actions, including exporting project data.

Fixes

  • 3D reference videos attach to the video composer again.
  • Seedance reference videos shorter than 4 seconds are extended with black automatically instead of being rejected.
  • Nano Banana 2 Lite offers 1K only, the size Google accepts.
  • An expired video in the 3D Composer is now labeled "Expired".
  • Bikes and cars built from parts no longer drive backwards, and riders face the way they ride.
  • A crowd placed by 3D Paul now shows different people instead of copies of one person.

Promptr Studio Pro 5.119

Fixes

  • Interface improvements and minor bug fixes.
